# eSIM.dog: full product and price catalogue

> Prepaid travel eSIMs with fixed data allowances, daily high-speed allowances, configurable unlimited plans and regional coverage.

Base price snapshot: 2026-11-12. Currency: USD. Each price is for the complete stated package or billing period. Tax may be added at checkout as shown on the product page.

## Products and help
- Country plans: fixed data, or a selectable number of days for unlimited plans. https://esim.dog/
- Regional plans: packages covering several countries. Coverage is listed with each group below. https://esim.dog/regions
- WorldPass: global data subscription. https://esim.dog/worldpass

WorldPass prices exclude the optional UK phone number, which is preselected on the product page. Turn off Add a phone number to buy WorldPass alone.

## Reading the catalogue
Find the destination in a directory below. For fixed packages, search COUNTRY: fixed SIZE. For daily or fully unlimited plans, search its single-word key, then read the matching price block, not just the directory entry. Copy names, units and keys exactly. If a search returns other countries or only the directory, find the country heading COUNTRY (CODE) and read that section.

Every price is the total USD charge for the stated package and duration. Prices use explicit duration=value pairs: 13=13.09 means 13 days cost USD 13.09. A comma lists alternative durations and a range includes every whole day: 1,6-8=2.55 means 1, 6, 7 or 8 days each cost USD 2.55. Semicolons separate prices; the position of a number never determines its duration.
Country fixed tables keep all variants of one data allowance together. Read the requested duration for each variant to compare prices, including ties. Each country has one Fixed Buy template immediately below its country heading. Use that template for its fixed packages: set {g} to the data= value directly below the requested size heading (or the row's own data= value), set {d} to the chosen duration, and copy {r} exactly from the row's explicit r= value. For Black2 r=black, use route=black. The variant number is never part of the URL. For conditions, search the country name and bare variant ID together, for example Japan Yellow1; omit data=, pick= and r= suffixes. Variant numbers identify the country-specific conditions table. Networks and internet exit belong to that variant only. 'See product page' supplies no network name.
A row marked pick=2 or higher is another option of the same colour. Append &plan= followed by that row's complete p= key, including rp_, to select it directly. Copy only the key after p=, not the pick number. The key applies to the durations on that row.
Each unlimited plan has a lookup key repeated at the start of every price row. Its destination, daily allowance or continuous speed, networks, Buy template and all duration-price pairs are in the same short block. The directories give a destination code and plan suffixes. Join the code and suffix without spaces to form the lookup key. Match that key on the price row containing the requested duration. Set {d} in that plan's Buy template to the chosen duration.
Purple fully unlimited plans have no daily quota. Other unlimited plans give a daily high-speed allowance that resets each day, followed by unlimited data at the stated speed. Country fixed variants are full-speed data with hotspot except Amber Essential, which has a 1 Mbps speed cap and no hotspot.
For regional fixed packages, all offers for the same data allowance and duration share one line, ordered by total USD price. Form its lookup key by joining the region code, the data allowance and the number of days followed by d. Read every offer on that line, including ties. Each offer is variant=total USD@p; any bracketed calls/SMS belong to that offer. Use p in the Buy template above, set {d} to the requested duration, and replace data= only when that offer has its own data= value. For the complete coverage and networks of a variant, search its region name followed by the bare variant ID in the region's Variant conditions table. Choose only variants covering every required country. A region's name does not guarantee coverage. Regional unlimited blocks contain their own coverage and prices. Coverage uses the country codes or names supplied with each offer.
Special-package rows state their category explicitly: Inflight and Cruise are different products. WorldPass rows state both initial payment and renewal; phone-number prices cover the whole stated term. Include the selected offer's completed purchase link in recommendations.

## Country unlimited-plan directory

Each line gives COUNTRY (CODE) followed by plan suffixes. Join CODE + suffix without spaces to obtain the heading key. daily3GB1Mbps means 3GB of high-speed data resetting each day, then unlimited data at 1 Mbps. unlimited1Mbps means no daily quota, at up to 1 Mbps. Other sizes and speeds follow the same notation; full terms are in each plan block.

## WorldPass data and coverage
Every WorldPass term includes one shared USD 30.00 monthly Fast Data Wallet across the supported countries and networks. The GB amounts below show how far that same wallet goes if used on the listed network; they are not separate allowances to add together. Unused wallet rolls over for up to 3 months.
After the fast-data wallet is exhausted, slower unlimited data is available only on networks marked yes. Networks marked no need a top-up after fast data is exhausted.
